name: Emberhoard Squirrel
lore: Born in a hollow the first wildfire never quite finished eating, it learned to hoard what fire leaves behind. Its cheeks glow with borrowed embers, and the acorns it buries smolder for years before they split. Treasure-hunters who follow the faint smell of smoke find only their own scorched footprints leading back.
design: A small red squirrel in a scorched hollow, its cheeks glowing like embers as it hoards acorns that smolder, painted in warm autumnal concept art.

name: Ruincrest Chicken
lore: No one remembers which empire it once belonged to, only that it refuses to leave the rubble. It scratches through ash for seed and memory alike, its ragged comb lit by the last ember of a dead hearth. To hear it crow at dusk is said to be an omen that the ruins are about to remember your name.
design: A gaunt shadow chicken with a hunched silhouette, ragged tail feathers trailing like torn cloth, a thin hooked beak and a jagged comb. Feathers read as matte smoke and soot, edges fraying into wisps, eyes glowing faint ember. It leans forward mid-step, wings half-spread, expression wary and sly. Palette of charcoal grey, bruised purple, and dim amber glow against a broken stone ruin at dusk. cartoonish, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Gloamstag of the Tundra
lore: It walks the white emptiness where the sun is a rumor and the moon is a landlord. Its antlers shed not velvet but smoke, writing brief dark runes against the snow that vanish before they can be read. Travelers who glimpse it swear it was waiting for them, and that it already knew the way home.
design: A tall slender deer with long branching antlers trailing wisps of smoke, its lean silhouette sharpened by thin legs and a ragged mane. Matte charcoal hide, curling shadow-smoke instead of fur along the spine, hooves like polished jet. It strides forward, head tilted, hollow glowing eyes calm and unreadable. Ink black, bruised violet and cold blue haze. It crosses a wind-scoured snow plain under a dim moon. cartoonish, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Cryptshade Cat
lore: It was interred with a noble house and simply never agreed to leave. By day it is a smudge of soot between the coffins; by night it is the reason the candles gutter. It keeps the vault tidy, chasing out mice and lesser ghosts alike, and has never once knocked over an urn it did not mean to.
design: A compact crouching cat with oversized ears, a bottle-brush tail and shoulders hunched into a rounded silhouette. Its short fur is soot-dark and dusty, ribbed with faint smoky stripes that bleed off the edges into curling vapour. It freezes mid-prowl, pupils wide and wary, one paw lifted. Plum shadow, warm ember-grey and dim candle amber. It slinks between toppled stone coffins in a dusty vault. cartoonish, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Cinderstalk Tiger
lore: When the old forest burned, one tiger refused to run and the fire made a home in it instead. Its stripes are seams of molten ember that breathe with every low growl. It pads through the blackened trunks at dusk, and the charred woods lean in to listen when it passes.
design: A massive forest tiger with a broad heavy frame, short powerful legs and a blunt square head, its striped coat of charcoal shadow-smoke smoldering with molten ember seams that glow through the fur. It pads forward low and deliberate, shoulders rolling, head tilted with a slow predatory smirk. Palette of soot black, deep crimson and glowing orange with faint purple smoke haze. Setting: a charred woodland clearing where embers drift between blackened trunks. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Thornwhisker Prowler
lore: It is not made of grass so much as grown from it; every blade on its coat leans toward the light it is hunting. In spring its tail opens into a seed-head and the meadow quietly reseeds itself wherever it walks. Farmers leave it a saucer of milk and a wide berth. It has never been caught, only thanked.
design: A sleek cat of grass, silhouette defined by a long arcing tail ending in a feathered seed-head and tall ears sprouting reed blades. Fur is fine turf-like grass with visible individual blades, paw pads like soft clover, eyes glowing pale green. Crouched low in a playful hunter's stalk, one paw raised, whiskers of bent grass, tail curled high with a sly, mischievous grin. Fresh spring green shading into yellow-green highlights, dandelion fluff drifting. Setting: a wildflower meadow with tall swaying grass. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Voltwhisker Mouse
lore: Lightning struck a granary, and something small and defiant inside decided to keep the charge. Now it stands on its hind legs in the middle of storms, cheeks puffed, daring the thunder to try again. The arcs between its ears can light a lantern, or stop a larger predator's heart, whichever comes first.
design: A small but mighty mouse of electric charge, silhouette compact with huge round ears like lightning rods and a long tail that forks into sparking filaments. Fur is a bristling static fuzz, whiskers are fine arcing wires, paws tipped with tiny glowing claws, body traced by crackling arc-light. It stands on hind legs, back arched, cheeks puffed mid-shout, sparks leaping between its ears. Bright electric yellow and white-hot arcs against deep violet shadows. Setting: a storm-dark plain humming with charge. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Stormtooth Beaver
lore: It dammed a river with felled trees and, one summer, with a thunderhead that got too close. Now its buck teeth glow like charged copper and its flat tail hums with current. The marsh around its lodge is permanently bright with blue-white sparks, and the fish have learned to swim around it.
design: A stocky beaver with a broad flat tail that splits into crackling lightning-shaped ridges, its fur a bristling storm-grey shot through with white-hot filaments, incisors glowing like charged copper. Static arcs leap between its buck teeth and the tips of its twitching ears, and its flattened tail hums with blue-white current. It stands braced on a half-chewed log, nervous and jittery, sparks popping from its paws. Palette of storm violet, electric blue and burnt copper. Setting: a flooded timber marsh under a gathering thunderhead. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Nightstorm Lion
lore: Its mane is a standing storm that never breaks, black smoke curling from the tip of every bolt. It was born in the seam between a thundercloud and a moonless night, and it belongs to neither. When it roars, the sky answers with silent lightning and the plateau holds its breath.
design: A colossal lion whose mane erupts into a crown of branching lightning, each strand fraying into curls of black smoke at the tips, so the silhouette reads as a great solar flare around a heavy feline body. Its hide is plated in storm-cloud velvet and scorched obsidian, chipped along the shoulders, with arcs of blue-white charge crawling between the plates and tiny embers of soot drifting from its paws. It stands mid-roar, one forepaw raised, jaw wide, eyes glowing like split filaments, tail lashing a thin whip of current. Deep indigo and charcoal dominate, cut by jagged violet-white arcs and the dull orange of dying embers. It prowls a shattered night plateau beneath a sky torn by silent lightning. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Frostarc Badger
lore: It dens in the glacier where the ice is thinnest, so the charge beneath the world can reach it. Jagged prisms bristle down its back, and arcs leap between the shards whenever it snarls. It has dug through frozen rivers for a living and regards the thaw as a personal insult.
design: A stocky badger with a broad wedge-shaped head and a low, powerful silhouette, its back bristling with jagged ice prisms that crackle with forked arcs of blue-white electricity leaping between the shards. Its fur is coarse frost-rimed guard hair over dense underfur, the claws translucent like frozen crystal, while thin veins of glowing charge run beneath the skin of its shoulders and snout, and its breath puffs as glittering frost. It stands braced and snarling, shoulders hunched, jaws parted to show icicle teeth, eyes narrowed and defiantly bright. Colour story: glacier cyan and deep indigo pricked with hot violet arc-light and pale foam-white highlights. Setting: a frozen riverbank at dusk, shattered ice plates glowing faintly underfoot. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Mossgloom Stag
lore: Its antlers flower with seed-heads that never fall, even as the shadow around its hooves drinks the light. It walks the border where meadow becomes forest, and both bow as it passes. Poachers who follow its pollen trail come back years later, gently, with no memory of hunting at all.
design: A tall slender stag whose antlers unfurl into branching green stalks tipped with seed heads, its elegant silhouette half-swallowed by curling shadow. Its hide is velvet moss and bark texture, spotted with luminous pollen that drifts from its flanks, while the shadow pooling around its legs is dense ink-black smoke threaded with glowing spores. It steps forward with regal calm, head lifted, one foreleg raised delicately, eyes serene and knowing, a faint green light burning in them. Colour story: deep forest emerald and sunlit chartreuse against bruised violet-black shadow. Setting: a moonlit meadow edge where tall grass fades into a wall of dark trees. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Emberleap Hare
lore: It outran a grass fire and carried a spark of it away in its heels. Now every leap leaves a line of tiny flames in the grass, and its ears trail ribbons of smoke that unravel behind it. It is not cruel, only fast, and it thinks the whole burning world is a game worth winning.
design: A small hare with an exaggerated lean silhouette, long ears streaming backward into ribbons of flame, hind legs coiled and oversized with heat-shimmer blurring their edges. Its fur is singed velvet streaked with soot, ear-tips and paws glowing like coals, whiskers thin filaments of ember, tufts of ash drifting from its tail. It is caught mid-leap, body stretched, ears flattened flat and eyes wide with wild glee, a tiny fierce grin showing. Colour story: scorched charcoal and deep rust shot through with blazing orange, yellow sparks and drifting grey soot. Setting: a blackened grassland at night where small fires smoulder between wildflowers. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Shadefang Hound
lore: It belonged to a gatekeeper who stepped into the dark and never stepped back out. The hound kept the post anyway, ribs showing through charcoal fur, eyes two red pinpricks in a cloud of smoke. It snarls at anything that tries to pass, and quietly lets through whoever the old gatekeeper would have.
design: A lean, low-slung hound whose back arches into a jagged ridge of bristling fur, its silhouette all sharp shoulders and a tail that tapers to a smoky wisp. Its hide looks like matte charcoal velvet dusted with ash, ribs faintly showing, and where its eyes and maw open there is only curling black smoke with two dim ember-red pinpricks. It slinks forward with head lowered and teeth bared in a silent snarl, wary and predatory. The palette is deep charcoal, soot grey, and bruised violet with a single dull red glow. It prowls a moonless alley of drifting shadow. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents.

name: Voltstag
lore: It grazes the rain-slick meadow just before a storm, antlers raised like rods waiting for the strike. Charge runs in circuit-veins beneath its metallic coat, and droplets hang frozen around it in defiance of gravity. It is more curious than dangerous, but it has never learned not to touch things.
design: A slender stag crowned with antlers that split into branching lightning rods, each tine crackling with blue-white arc-light, its hide a sleek storm-grey coat streaked with glowing circuit-like veins of charge. Its fur is short and metallic, faintly humming, the antler tips capped in copper nodes that spark and shed tiny forked filaments, while static lifts the fur along its spine into a soft electric bristle. It stands mid-step, one foreleg raised and poised, head tilted with alert, startled curiosity, eyes wide and luminous. The colour story is electric cobalt and silver-white against dusky indigo, with hot violet accents where arcs jump. It pauses in a rain-slick meadow just before a thunderhead, droplets suspended around its antlers. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Cinderlantern Firefly
lore: It was a lantern that flew into a furnace and decided it preferred the air. Its abdomen holds a coal-filled furnace's worth of heat, and its charred shell cracks with veins of ember. It dances over summer fields at dusk, trailing ash and delight, guiding lost travelers just far enough to lose them again.
design: A stout, round firefly with a lantern abdomen blazing like a coal-filled furnace, its whole shell charred black and veined with glowing ember cracks, wings translucent amber singed at the tips and shedding soot and sparks as it flies. Its body is soot-soft and velvet, the carapace flaking like burnt wood, tiny legs tipped in red-hot filament, and the lantern pulses with layered orange, gold, and deep crimson heat that spills smoke. It hovers eagerly, wings spread wide, expression bright and mischievous with wide delighted eyes. The palette burns in molten orange, scorched black, and cherry red against a smoky taupe haze. It dances above a summer field at dusk, drifting ash motes rising around it. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Glaciermane Steed
lore: Its mane shatters into crystal shards and grows back overnight; its hooves are clear as glacier glass. It was carved by a winter that outlived its own season, and it has been running ever since to keep warm. On a frozen lake at dusk, its breath hangs in the air longer than the cold should allow.
design: A proud horse of living ice, its silhouette lean and sculptural with a long flowing mane that fans into jagged crystal shards and a tail like a frozen waterfall. Its body is faceted translucent blue-white ice, hairline fractures catching prismatic light, hooves clear as glacier glass, breath curling into frost plumes. It stands rearing slightly, head arched high, ears tipped forward, eyes calm and knowing, an icy exhalation drifting from flared nostrils. Palette of pale glacier blue, deep frost navy, and prismatic rainbow glints over snow white. It stands atop a frozen lake at dusk, a low winter sun breaking through ice fog. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Gravewing Owl
lore: It nests in the dead branch above the graveyard and keeps a ledger of everyone who passes beneath it. Its feathers fray into drifting smoke, and its violet eyes are the last thing many small creatures see. It is not malicious; it is simply thorough, and it never forgets a face.
design: A hooded owl of shadow, its silhouette broad and cloaked with ragged wing-feathers that fray into drifting smoke. Its plumage is soft charcoal and ink-black, smoking at the edges, with faint purple underglow seeping from between the vanes, and talons of polished obsidian. It perches hunched and watchful, one wing half-spread, head turned back over its shoulder, huge luminous violet eyes narrowing in a silent predator's stare. Palette of deep shadow black, bruised violet, and pale moon-grey accents. It sits on a dead twisted branch above a misted graveyard in low fog. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Pyremane Steed
lore: Its mane and tail are banners of open flame, and its hide a crust of cooled lava over a molten heart. It was the last horse to leave a burning plain and the only one that came back for the rest. When it rears, the night sky turns the color of the ground it left behind.
design: A mighty horse of living flame, silhouette powerful and wild with a mane and tail of roaring fire that streams upward like banners, hooves trailing sparks. Its hide is cracked blackened soot over molten seams, embers glowing between plates, breath venting smoke and cinders. It rears mid-gallop, forelegs raised, nostrils flared, eyes blazing, expression defiant and untamed. Palette of deep ember orange, searing yellow-white, and charred black with soot accents. Setting is a scorched volcanic plain at night, ash drifting through the hot updrafts. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Tidefetch Hound
lore: It is less a dog than a wave that learned loyalty. Its coat runs in currents, its collar is foam, and its paws leave ripples on dry stone. It will fetch anything thrown into the sea, sometimes even things that were never thrown, that the ocean had been keeping for years.
design: A loyal dog of water, silhouette sleek and athletic with a curling tail and a back fin-like crest of foam, ears flowing like ribbons of current. Its body is semi-translucent liquid blue, fur rendered as streaming currents and droplets, paws leaving ripples, with a foaming collar around the neck. It bounds forward joyfully, front paws lifted, mouth open in a happy panting grin, tongue splashing into droplets, eyes bright and eager. Palette of deep ocean blue, turquoise, and crisp white foam accents. Setting is a sunlit rocky shore where waves crash and spray hangs in rainbow mist. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Stonewhisker Cat
lore: Its body is mortared from boulder and loam, and moss grows where the plates meet. It has sat on the same hillside for longer than the village below has existed, and it regards the passing centuries as mildly interesting. When it finally stretches, whole fields shift.
design: A mighty feline with a robust, statuesque silhouette, its body covered in plates of stone and soil, with moss growing in the crevices. Its fur is a mix of textured rock and rich loam, and its eyes are polished amber gems. It stands tall and proud, tail raised, one paw resting on a boulder, expression calm and commanding. The palette is earthy: deep browns, ochres, and mossy greens, with veins of gold and copper. The setting is an ancient forest clearing with towering trees and a carpet of fallen leaves. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Frostplume Chicken
lore: It was a farmyard hen that survived a winter no one else did and came out the other side glassy and glowing. Its comb is a crown of icy spikes, and moonlight pools inside its translucent breast. It struts across the frozen pond like it owns the season, and as far as the pond is concerned, it does.
design: A rotund ice chicken with a plump, rounded silhouette, its feathers transformed into overlapping frosty shards and its comb a crown of icy spikes. The body is glassy and semi-translucent, with a soft inner glow like frozen moonlight, while its beak and legs are polished blue crystal. It stands proudly, chest puffed, one wing raised as if mid-flap, eyes wide with a comically fierce determination. The color story is pale cyan, frost white, and deep sapphire shadows. It struts across a frozen pond, snowflakes drifting around its clawed feet. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Cindercomb Chicken
lore: Something in the smoldering farmyard decided a chicken would make a fine little volcano. Its feathers are scorched-copper shingles with ember edges, and its legs are cooling lava crust. It crows at dawn to wake the ash, and the ash always rises.
design: A compact, fierce barnyard chicken with an exaggeratedly tall, jagged comb and a fan of stiff tail feathers that flare like a small flame. Its plumage is layered like scorched copper shingles, tipped with glowing ember edges and dusted with fine soot, while its scaly legs look like cooling lava crust. It struts forward with chest thrust out and one claw lifted, beak open in a defiant crow, eyes narrowed and bold. The palette runs deep charcoal and burnt umber into vivid orange, crimson, and gold highlights. It stands in a smoldering farmyard of cracked earth and drifting sparks. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Claymane Stallion
lore: Its mane is braided roots and its hide is craggy clay veined with jade and copper. It was shaped from the standing stones of a plateau that grew tired of standing still. When it paws the ground, the cracks spread a little farther, and somewhere a mountain feels the itch.
design: A mighty draft horse with a heavy arched neck, braided mane of woven roots, and hooves like rounded boulders. Its hide is craggy clay and stone, ridged with mineral veins and crusted with patches of soil and lichen, though its eyes glow with warm, living light and its breath puffs faint dust. It rears slightly, forelegs lifted, mane tossing, expression calm but immensely powerful. The palette is terracotta, sandstone, and deep brown with jade and amber mineral accents. It stands on a windswept plateau of cracked earth and scattered standing stones. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Blazefang Lynx
lore: It is a plains cat that chased two storms at once and caught a piece of each. Ember-fur crackles with arc-light, and its whiskers spit sparks when it grins. It hunts in the dry grass at dusk, and the thunderheads on the horizon lean toward it like old friends.
design: A lean, long-legged plains cat with a whip-thin tail and tall pointed ears, its hide a crackling pelt of scorched ember-fur veined with bright arc-light. It crouches mid-pounce, back arched, whiskers sparking, mouth open in a fierce grin, one paw raised to strike. Palette of amber gold, burnt orange and charcoal black split by jagged white-blue lightning flashes. Setting: dry grass plains at dusk with distant thunderheads and drifting ash. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Forgeheart Cat
lore: It dozes by the blacksmith's forge and pretends not to be made of fire. Ember runes glow faintly through its fur, and its tail curls into small, well-behaved flames. The smith long ago stopped questioning it, and simply sets out a second bowl of milk, warm of course.
design: A plump tabby cat dozes by a blacksmith's forge, its fur faintly glowing with ember runes as small flames curl from its tail; warm, painterly character concept.

name: Frostdam Beaver
lore: Its flat tail is a slab of crystal that splits light into color, and frost shards tile its back. It builds its dams in the coldest reaches of the river, where the current freezes mid-sentence. The crypt it dens beside was old when the ice first came, and it has outlasted every attempt to thaw it.
design: A compact beaver with a crystalline flat tail refracting light, its fur frosted into pale prismatic shards along the back and ears. Icy crust over glossy pelt, breath fogging into glittering frost motes. It crouches low, ears flat, watchful and still amid the cold. Palette of pale glacier blue, bone white, and faint violet prism shimmer. A shadowed stone crypt dusted with frost and old carvings. cartoonish, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Cheshire Glutton
passive_text: Incoming damage to the party is reduced by 6%.
lore: It has never once stopped smiling, not through famines, sieges, or the day the fishmonger closed. Nobody can tell whether the grin is a threat or a joke, and the cat has declined to clarify. It is enormously fat, appallingly slow, and, as every thief in the district has learned, impossible to knock over.
design: A hugely overweight tabby cat with a perfectly circular silhouette and a grin stretched ear to ear, cheeks dimpled, eyes crinkled into pleased crescents. Fur is plush ginger-and-cream with darker marbled stripes, a soft wobbly belly spilling over stubby paws, and a tail curled into a neat question mark. It sits like a monument, chin lifted and unbothered, one paw raised as if mid-wave. Warm honeyed palette against a dim tavern corner with a plate of half-eaten fish. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Brawnhare
passive_text: +6% ATK for every other physical card in the party.
lore: It was the runt of a litter that survived by lifting twice its weight in turnips every morning. Now its haunches are carved from corded muscle, and its ears flex like steel cables when it tenses. It has never lost an arm-wrestle with anything smaller than a boulder, and it is still furious about the boulder.
design: A compact, hyper-muscular hare standing on hind legs, shoulders bulging, chest broad and veined, front paws clenched into fists. Short dense fur of warm brown over exaggerated deltoids and thighs, long ears swept back like a boxer's headguard, one ear nicked. It glares forward in a braced stance with a tiny fierce scowl under a twitching nose. Palette of warm russet, cream underbelly, and hard shadow against a dusty training yard with a snapped tree stump. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Puffball Chicken
passive_text: Redirects 5% of damage aimed at allies into its own feathers.
lore: It is less a chicken than a sphere of down that happens to have opinions. Its feathers have grown so thick and buoyant that weapons simply sink into them and lose their nerve. It has survived three fox raids, two winters, and one attempt to use it as a pillow, all without changing its expression by a single degree.
design: A perfectly spherical chicken, so fluffed with down that its beak and feet barely protrude, forming an absurd round silhouette. Feathers are marshmallow-soft layered cream and pale gold, ruffled in dense overlapping rings, the comb lost entirely in the fluff. It stands stub-legged with wings splayed uselessly for balance, eyes two happy black beads, a faint surprised blink. Palette of warm vanilla, butter yellow, and soft shadow against a sunlit barn floor scattered with straw. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Blazefleece Ram
passive_text: The first attack each run scorches the attacker for 10% of its ATK.
lore: It grazes on scorched slopes where nothing else will grow, its wool smoldering gently as it chews. The horns are the hottest part; shepherds mark their flocks by the color of the flame off a ram's brow. It is a patient, heavy animal, right up until it decides to headbutt a mountain.
design: A stout ram with massive spiraling horns whose tips glow like forge-heated iron, its thick fleece smoldering in seams of ember and drifting ash. The wool reads as magma-crusted curls over dark basalt hide, chest broad and low to the ground, split hooves like cooling lava. It paws the ground mid-charge, head lowered, eyes narrowed and furious, a plume of smoke curling from its nostrils. Palette of deep char, burnt sienna, and searing orange against an ashen hillside. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Barkscale Serpent
passive_text: +10% ATK while any grass card survives in the party.
lore: It does not slither so much as unfurl, each scale a plate of living bark that creaks like an old branch. Hunters mistake it for a fallen log until the log opens an eye. It sleeps for a season at a time, rooted in the riverbank, and wakes hungry enough to swallow the season whole.
design: A long serpent whose body is made of overlapping bark plates, moss furring the seams and small branches sprouting along its spine. Its head is a blunt wedge of weathered oak with knots for eyes and a forked twig tongue, mouth hinged wide. It rears up from a coil, splintered tail switching, expression ancient and patient. Palette of moss green, bark brown, and pale lichen grey against a misty forest floor crowded with ferns. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Tideneck Tortoise
passive_text: Reduces the party's dungeon power requirement by 4%.
lore: Its neck uncoils like a length of kelp, long enough to browse the seafloor without ever moving its shell. Sailors tie messages to its neck and let it wander; not all of them arrive. It has seen every coast at least twice and considers the whole ocean a single, slowly turning garden.
design: An enormous sea turtle carved from living crystal, its faceted shell a dome of translucent blue-teal gemstone with prismatic light refracting through the panes and veins of inner glow tracing the seams. A long neck of segmented crystal scutes arcs up to a small, serene turtle's head with gentle dark eyes, and broad oar-like flippers catch rainbow glints as they stroke, patches of coral and algae clinging where the facets meet. It glides mid-stroke through green-blue water, neck curling in a lazy S. Palette of deep ocean teal, crystal jade, and abalone shimmer against shafts of light through kelp. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Boulderbelly Frog
lore: It sits so still that villages build walls around it before anyone notices it is a frog. Its skin is a mosaic of boulders and lichen, and its croak rolls down the valley like an avalanche starting. When it finally shifts, the ground remembers to move with it.
design: A colossal toad carved from stacked boulders, granite plates for skin with moss and quartz veins in the cracks, eyes two polished amber domes. It crouches low and square, throat inflated, front legs like quarry blocks, each toe capped in flint. Dense and immovable, dust sifting from its back as it turns its head. Palette of granite grey, ochre, and moss green against a misted mountain quarry. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Thunderfang Wolf
passive_text: +5% ATK while any electric card is in the party.
lore: It runs ahead of every storm, howling to call the lightning down and then racing it home. Its fur stands on end in a permanent bristle, and its fangs hold a charge long after the sky has gone quiet. It has never been struck, which it interprets as a standing invitation.
design: A lean, long-legged wolf with bristling storm-grey fur shot through with white-hot filaments, arcs jumping between its ears and the ridge of its back. Fangs glow like charged copper, eyes bright electric blue, a collar of static fuzz around the neck. It lopes forward mid-stride, jaws parted in a silent howl, paws leaving scorch prints. Palette of storm indigo, electric blue, and silver against a dark plain beneath a gathering thunderhead. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Sunbloom Lion
passive_text: Restores 3% party power at the start of each run.
lore: Its mane is a living crown of sunflowers that turns to face the light, even underground. Where it sleeps, the soil turns black and rich, and next spring a ring of new blooms points toward the spot. It is gentle with everything except shade.
design: A proud lion whose mane is a single enormous sunflower, its petals radiating outward in one dense golden disc with the lion's face set at the center like a dark seed-heart, a few thick stalks and leaves trailing down the neck. Body is warm tawny fur over lean muscle, paws and tail tipped with green shoots, eyes bright amber. It stands head high, the great bloom turning slowly toward the sun, pollen and drifting seeds behind it. Palette of sunflower gold, olive green, and warm umber against a bright meadow at noon. cartoonish digital illustration, dramatic rim lighting, rich saturated color with accents

name: Gloomstalker Tiger
lore: It has no outline of its own, only the suggestion of one where the dark refuses to sit still. Villages leave it offerings not out of fear but habit, and the offerings are always gone by morning. It has never been photographed, painted, or believed, which suits it perfectly.
design: A massive tiger rendered almost entirely in layered shadow, its stripes darker voids cut by faint violet underglow, eyes two luminous points.
